scope: Evidence for the pattern section only. Metrics from the legacy length-8 and isolated length-32 experiments are deliberately kept separate.

legacy_length8.task: All 16 binary patterns of length 4 in sequences of length 8; masked MLP has 8 hidden units and each hard mask has 32 active edges.

two_decoder_agreement.protocol: One OOD split (42), two frozen unconditional CVAEs (seeds 42 and 43), 64 latent-pair starts; agreement uses no gold support and no held-out labels.

oracle_reachability.meaning: Gold-guided diagnostic, not transfer: only z is optimized against the ideal mask in frozen decoders.

single_z_task_search.meaning: Label-using direct-gradient heuristic on VAE42, not a full bilevel hypergradient; it has a different compute/data budget from agreement.

length32_interpolation.task: Binary pattern occurrence in a length-32 bit sequence; CVAE train/validation lengths are 3,4,6,8 and test lengths 5,7 are completely absent from bank construction, CVAE fitting, and checkpoint selection.

protocol.bank: 1000 random exact-K masked MLPs per known task, 2000 Adam steps; select the best 100 by a disjoint 2048-example query BCE; train on normalized unsigned abs(W1*mask) maps.
protocol.cvae: Two seeds (42,43), latent 32, hidden 256, 80 epochs, BCE-sum plus 0.1 KL; condition is the continuous scalar 2*(length-3)/5-1.
protocol.evaluation: All 32 length-5 and all 128 length-7 patterns; 32 masks per CVAE seed, two fresh-MLP initializations, 2000 MLP steps, balanced 2048-example test. Every method has exactly 32*k active edges.

limits: Bootstrap intervals resample held-out patterns and are conditional on the two fitted CVAE seeds.
The exact result establishes interpolation within this synthetic task family, not extrapolation or transfer beyond it.
Correct-length conditioning changes generated masks but has not shown a functional advantage over either neighbouring known length.

figure_sources.use: One generated mask for each control at k=5 and k=7, columns matched to the analytic support only for visualization.
Oracle reachability witness; caption must state that gold is used.
